remarks: Spacious 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath condominium townhouse rental located at 84 Taylor Avenue, Apt 1, Norwalk. This well-maintained unit offers a functional multi-level layout with generous living space, ideal for comfortable everyday living. The townhouse-style design provides added privacy along with a true residential feel.  The unit features three well-sized bedrooms, one full bathroom and one half bath, ample closet space, and a practical floor plan suitable for a variety of living arrangements. Tenant is responsible for all utilities.  Monthly rent is $3,500 with a security deposit of $7,000 required. This is a condominium rental; association rules apply.  Conveniently located near major roadways, shopping, dining, and local amenities, offering easy access throughout Norwalk and surrounding areas.
